preconditions.description: The number of cities N must be between 2 and 200, and the number of roads M must be between 1 and 50,000.
The prices of gold (G) and silver (S) coins must be between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= N and 1 <= int(y) <= N and 1 <= int(g) <= 10**9 and 1 <= int(s) <= 10**9 for x, y, g, s in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[3:]])
preconditions.description: Each road must connect valid cities (1 to N) and have valid gold (g) and silver (s) requirements (1 to 10^9).

postconditions.description: The output must be either '<image>' (if no valid gift exists) or a non-negative integer representing the minimal cost in tugriks (up to 2 * 10^9 * 200).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= 10**9 and 1 <= b <= 10**9 for a, b in [(int(G), int(S))])
postconditions.description: The chosen gold (a) and silver (b) coins must be within valid bounds (1 to 10^9).

postconditions.expression: all(int(g) <= int(a) and int(s) <= int(b) for x, y, g, s in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[3:]] if stdout.strip() != '<image>')
postconditions.description: For the chosen gift (a gold, b silver), every road must satisfy g_i ≤ a and s_i ≤ b.

postconditions.expression: any(all(int(g) <= int(a) and int(s) <= int(b) for x, y, g, s in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[3:]]) and is_connected(int(N), int(a), int(b), [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[3:]]) if stdout.strip() != '<image>')
postconditions.description: The chosen gift must ensure that the graph is connected under the constraints (a, b), where is_connected(N, a, b, roads) checks if there exists a path between every pair of cities using only roads where g_i ≤ a and s_i ≤ b.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == min(int(G) * a + int(S) * b for a in range(1, 10**9 + 1) for b in range(1, 10**9 + 1) if all(int(g) <= a and int(s) <= b for x, y, g, s in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[3:]]) and is_connected(int(N), a, b, [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[3:]])) if any(all(int(g) <= a and int(s) <= b for x, y, g, s in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[3:]]) and is_connected(int(N), a, b, [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[3:]]) for a in range(1, 10**9 + 1) for b in range(1, 10**9 + 1)) else stdout.strip() == '<image>'
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimal cost (G*a + S*b) for a valid gift (a, b) that satisfies all constraints, or '<image>' if no such gift exists.
